cases.given: Single-host source and destination IPv4, TCP, and both ports blank/any in a local input
cases.expected: One directed flow is evaluated against synthetic inputs without contacting any real device

cases.given: Input has absent source address, a subnet instead of a host, or source port 65536
cases.expected: Reject malformed required values without treating an omitted port as an error

cases.given: Saved ACL has ordered r1 permit tcp 443 and r2 deny tcp 443 both matching
cases.expected: Return r1 and r2 in stored order, irrespective of their actions

cases.given: Port 443 against inclusive [443,443], nonmatching [444,445]; 192.0.2.4 against /24 and unrelated /24
cases.expected: Only containing inclusive ranges and containing networks match

cases.requirement: Relevance is a separate provided input
cases.expected: Exactly two output groups in first-seen order

cases.requirement: Relevance is a separate provided input
cases.given: Relevant pair fw-b/acl-2 has no available snapshot
cases.expected: Fail entire query with no partial successful output or invented NO_MATCH

cases.given: One relevant, valid snapshot contains no matching rule
cases.expected: Group reports NO_MATCH and empty rules, not an implicit deny

cases.given: Relevant ACLs fw-b/acl-2 and fw-a/acl-1 each have ordered stored matches
cases.expected: JSON output preserves relevance and snapshot ordering and rule evidence, no global verdict

cases.given: Stored snapshot has malformed or unsupported required matching field and another rule with opaque extra text
cases.expected: Reject an unsupported required matcher without successful partial output; opaque extras alone do not fail

cases.given: Run with synthetic input and local stored snapshots in isolated environment
cases.expected: No network or device activity; result only from supplied evidence

cases.given: TCP 10.0.0.5:any to 192.0.2.10:443; source port restrictions differ across otherwise matching ACL rows
cases.expected: Both source-restricted rows remain eligible when every specified query dimension matches

cases.given: UDP 10.0.0.5:53000 to 192.0.2.10:any; saved ACL contains different destination port restrictions
cases.expected: Destination port restrictions do not exclude rules when that query port is unrestricted

cases.given: One query 10.0.0.5:55000 to 192.0.2.10:443 and additional reverse-only ACL evidence
cases.expected: Return only rules for the requested direction; reverse search requires another request

cases.given: A five-field matching ACL rule contains established and schedule conditions absent from the query
cases.expected: Keep the rule and original extra conditions visible; do not interpret their applicability

cases.given: One saved ACL rule has an unsupported required matcher; another has only extra uninterpreted text
cases.expected: Unsupported required matcher is reported as invalid; opaque extra text alone is preserved

cases.requirement: Relevance is a separate provided input
cases.given: One named ACL is attached to inbound interface and globally on the same FW
cases.expected: Output one ACL group with both bindings and one copy of each matched rule

cases.requirement: Relevance is a separate provided input
cases.given: A relevant synthetic FW has no ACL bound at applicable places
cases.expected: Represent the FW without an ACL name, not an invented ACL or implicit deny

cases.given: ACL-A was last read successfully at 10:00, ACL-B at 10:05; ACL-A failed refresh at 11:00
cases.expected: ACL-A date remains 10:00 and ACL-B date 10:05; failed read does not update date
